section.title: The Cut Rule

entry.mathphrase: Γ ⊢ Δ, A Γ', A ⊢ Δ'

section.para: Gentzen's Hauptsatz states that the Cut rule is admissible in LK: any sequent provable using the Cut rule is also provable without it. This implies that derivations in LK can be transformed into a normal form that does not use Cut.
